**What is EMI?**

EMI stands for Equated Monthly Installment, which is the fixed amount you pay each month to repay a loan. In your case, the EMI is $313.36, due on or before the 8th day of each month, starting from November 8, 2025.

The EMI is calculated based on the loan amount, interest rate, and tenure of the loan. It remains the same throughout the loan period, unless you make any changes to the loan terms.

Here's how it works: your EMI is applied first to any accrued interest and then to the principal balance. This means that each month, you'll pay a portion of the interest and a portion of the loan amount.

This information is based on your loan agreement, which outlines the terms and conditions of your loan, including the EMI amount and payment schedule.
